name: Male Infertility Due to NANOS1 Mutation
aliases: Genetic Male Infertility Associated with NANOS1 Mutation

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: NANOS1 Mutation Male Infertility Diagnostic Criteria

criteria.description: Identification of pathogenic or likely pathogenic mutation in the NANOS1 gene by genetic testing
Presence of azoospermia or severe oligozoospermia confirmed by semen analysis
Exclusion of other known causes of male infertility such as obstructive azoospermia, hormonal imbalances, or chromosomal abnormalities
Testicular biopsy showing impaired spermatogenesis or Sertoli cell-only syndrome

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of pathogenic NANOS1 mutation plus azoospermia or severe oligozoospermia with exclusion of other causes
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic counseling is recommended for affected individuals and families.

pathognomonic.notes: Complete absence of sperm in ejaculate due to spermatogenic failure
Markedly reduced sperm concentration in ejaculate

common.notes: Reduced testicular volume compared to age-matched controls
Defective sperm production identified on histological examination
Normal development of male secondary sexual features

rare.notes: Undescended testis present in some cases
Emotional impact secondary to infertility diagnosis
searchTerms: psychological issues related to inability to conceive

laboratory: Semen analysis showing azoospermia or severe oligozoospermia
Normal or mildly decreased serum testosterone
imaging: Scrotal ultrasound may show testicular hypotrophy or varicocele
genetic: Pathogenic or likely pathogenic variants in NANOS1 gene confirmed by molecular genetic testing
other: Testicular biopsy showing impaired spermatogenesis or Sertoli cell-only syndrome

distinguishingFeatures: Elevated FSH and LH with low testosterone
Evidence of ductal obstruction on imaging or vasography

redFlags: Complete azoospermia with no sperm retrieval on testicular biopsy
Family history of male infertility or genetic disorders
Failure to respond to hormonal or medical therapy for infertility
references: Kusz-Zamelczyk K, et al. NANOS1 mutations impair male fertility by disrupting spermatogenesis. Hum Genet. 2021.
Orphanet: Male infertility due to NANOS1 mutation (ORPHA:352613)
World Health Organization. WHO Laboratory Manual for the Examination and Processing of Human Semen, 6th Edition, 2021.
